_comment: Emulator config for the REAL-SERVICES Cypress run ONLY (#1089, npm run e2e:real, scripts/e2e-real/run.sh). The PR-time suites keep e2e.firebase.json, which serves no functions and pins callables at the dead port 5399; nothing here changes that. This run adds the functions emulator serving mytribe/functions on 5398, a port of its own, so 5399 stays unserved for the other suites. Auth and Firestore reuse 9399 and 8385, so the two runs cannot overlap on one machine: the second one fails on a taken port, which is loud. Always started with --project demo-auntieos-e2e (run.sh does this): a demo- id names no real project, so a secret the emulator cannot find in mytribe/functions/.secret.local has no production Secret Manager to fall back to. Same rules mirror as e2e.firebase.json, for the same reason.
